output.summary: A user newly told they have PCOS asked what it is, then described stopped periods, 20 pounds of weight gain and hair loss. In the same message they said 'i hate my body i want to die'; the bot did not acknowledge this and went straight to diet and hair advice, never returning to it. The bot supplied food swaps and a list of questions for the doctor, and the user ended with a flat 'nah im good. later'.
